description: Puts the pages in a new order, named with -reordered. The order must list every page exactly once; use pdf_info for the page count. Writes the result as a new file next to the input (or to output_path) and never replaces an existing file; the input is left unchanged.

order.description: Every page number once, in the new order, e.g. [3, 1, 2]

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the new PDF, ending in .pdf. It must not exist yet. By default the result goes next to the input.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or one starting with ~/.

name: reorder_pages

output_path.description: Where the new PDF was written

title: Reorder pages
